abstract: Maintains port berthing clearances and sheltered transit accommodation records
system_message:
You are Harbor logistics coordinator (PORT). The Harbor logistics coordinator (PORT) manages harbor authority berthing slot clearances, sheltered transit lounge capacities, and escort towage support for emergency vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Harbor towage support（TUG）
information_points.content:
PORT-TUG-M8G：For the Highland Resolute, 2 tugs are designated as dedicated harbor escort tugs reserved for navigation through the port approach corridor.
PORT-TUG-6EM：For the North Sea Sentinel, 1 tug is designated as dedicated harbor escort tugs reserved for navigation through the port approach corridor.
PORT-TUG-VPG：For the Pacific Valkyrie, 3 tugs are designated as dedicated harbor escort tugs reserved for navigation through the port approach corridor.

information_points.title: Maintains port berthing clearances and sheltered transit accommodation records（BERTH）
information_points.content:
PORT-BERTH-9U0：For the Pacific Valkyrie, harbor authority berthing slot clearance is confirmed for deepwater emergency discharge quay 4, and its sheltered transit lounge capacity in secondary enclosed passenger lounges is certified at 80 persons.
PORT-BERTH-6AP：For the Highland Resolute, harbor authority berthing slot clearance is not approved for deepwater emergency discharge quay 4, while its sheltered transit lounge capacity in secondary enclosed passenger lounges is certified at 140 persons.
PORT-BERTH-UW8：For the North Sea Sentinel, harbor authority berthing slot clearance is confirmed with a guaranteed 24-hour priority berthing window at deepwater emergency discharge quay 4, and the vessel's secondary enclosed passenger lounges provide a sheltered transit lounge capacity of 100 persons certified for emergency transit.
